class.name: SceneryStreamingProvider
class.brief_description: Supplies scenery content to [SceneryStreamingServer] cell by cell, as the camera comes near.
class.description: The interface of a source of streamed content, the way a map tile server supplies tiles: [SceneryStreamingServer] asks for the content of a 1[code] [/code]km cell as the camera comes within the draw distance of it, hands it to the consumer of its kind ([method SceneryStreamingServer.content_set_consumer]) and lets it go once the camera has left. Register an instance with [method SceneryStreamingServer.provider_register]. A provider knows nothing of cameras, ranges or budgets: it says which cells it has ([method _get_chunk_cells]), how far their content reaches out of them ([method _chunk_get_overhang]) and which kinds it supplies ([method _get_content_kinds]), and supplies the cell it is asked for ([method _chunk_load]). It is never asked for a kind it does not supply. Only presentation is supplied so - what the simulation needs whatever the camera does (tracks, traction) never comes from a provider. This class is only the interface: implement it in C++ by overriding the virtual methods ([MaszynaLegacySBTTerrainProvider]), or in GDScript by overriding the [code]_[/code] methods. [method _chunk_load] runs on the streaming worker threads and must be safe there.

method.name: _chunk_get_overhang
method.description: How far the content of [param cell] reaches out of it [m]; the cell is asked for that much earlier. [code]0[/code] when it stays within.

method.name: _chunk_load
method.description: The content of [param cell] of [param kind] (a [enum ContentKind]): an [Array] of items of the type the kind names. Called on the streaming worker threads, for each kind of [method _get_content_kinds], every time the cell comes into reach again.

method.name: _get_chunk_cells
method.description: The cells ([code]floor(position / SceneryStreamingServer chunk size)[/code] on X and Z) the provider has content for. Asked for once, at [method SceneryStreamingServer.provider_register].

method.name: _get_content_kinds
method.description: The [enum ContentKind] values the provider supplies. Asked for once, at [method SceneryStreamingServer.provider_register].

method.name: chunk_get_overhang
method.description: How far the content of [param cell] reaches out of it [m] - [method _chunk_get_overhang], or a C++ provider's own.

method.name: chunk_load
method.description: The content of [param cell] of [param kind] - [method _chunk_load], or a C++ provider's own.

method.name: get_chunk_cells
method.description: The cells the provider has content for - [method _get_chunk_cells], or a C++ provider's own.

method.name: get_content_kinds
method.description: The kinds the provider supplies - [method _get_content_kinds], or a C++ provider's own.

constants.constant: Terrain: [MaszynaTrianglesChunkGeometry] items, taken by [code]MaszynaSceneryChunkRenderingServer[/code]. An item is at most [constant MaszynaTrianglesChunkGeometry.MAX_VERTICES] vertices.
Decoration models: [SceneryModelPlacement] items, taken by [E3DRenderingServer]. Named by nothing - no event or signal reaches them.
Ambient sounds: [ScenerySoundPlacement] items, looped by [code]ScenerySoundServer[/code] within their reach. Named by nothing - no event plays or stops them.
